summary: Explains there is one global play-level handler scope, and handlers are added in this order: roles in `roles:`, the `handlers:` section, roles from `import_role`, then roles from `include_role` (only after it runs). With duplicate names, the last loaded wins.
questions: Are handlers scoped to the role they're defined in?
Which handler wins if a role and my playbook define one with the same name?
When do handlers from include_role become available?
In what order are handlers loaded into a play?

answer_card.title: Handler insertion order
answer_card.answer_md:
Handlers share one global, play-level scope wherever they're defined. They're added to the play in this order:
1. Handlers from roles in the `roles:` section
2. Handlers from the `handlers:` section
3. Handlers from roles statically imported with `import_role`
4. Handlers from roles dynamically included with `include_role` (available only after that task runs)

If names collide, the last one loaded (per this order) is the one notified and run.
